# KGB 开场字幕（调用点 188b:2ce8）。三栏：key（原版英文；排版断行已还原为空白）、译文、出处。
Maksim Mikhailovich Rukov is my real name but I use other names;
column2: 我的真名是马克西姆·米哈伊洛维奇·鲁科夫，不过我也用别的名字；

column1: you see, I have made some enemies over the past few years.
column2: 你知道的，这几年我树了些敌人。

column1: I am an Intelligence officer...
column2: 我是一名情报官……

column1: A secret agent, if you prefer.
column2: 你要说是秘密特务也行。

column1: My current duties and whereabouts are classified, naturally.
column2: 我目前的任务和行踪，当然都是机密。

column1: The adventure you are about to experience is based on a series of incidents which took place back in August of 1991,
column2: 你即将经历的冒险，取材自 1991 年 8 月发生的一连串事件，

column1: a few days before these pictures were filmed in Moscow.
column2: 就在这些画面于莫斯科拍摄的几天前。

column1: As you know, the putsch was defeated;
column2: 如你所知，那场政变失败了；

column1: I like to imagine that was due in some measure to me.
column2: 我喜欢想象那多少有我的功劳。

column1: And yet, my uncle Vanya points out, if I am a hero, it is only because I managed not to get myself killed!
column2: 不过我的万尼亚叔叔说，我若算是英雄，也只是因为我没把自己弄死！

column1: I have always felt Vanya has a tendancy to exagerate.
column2: 我一直觉得万尼亚说话爱夸张。

column1: Believe me, I did not choose to become a KGB officer:
column2: 相信我，当上 KGB 军官不是我自己选的：

column1: that 'privilege' was accorded me just before the events described in this adventure.
column2: 这份「殊荣」是在这次冒险的事件发生前不久才落到我头上的。

column1: Until then, I had been a Soviet soldier.
column2: 在那之前，我是一名苏联军人。

column1: Not an ordinary soldier, I grant you...
column2: 我承认，不是普通的军人……

column1: Spetsnaz are elite troops, trained for sabotage and intelligence operations deep behind enemy lines.
column2: 特种部队（Spetsnaz）是精锐部队，受训专门深入敌后运行破坏与情报任务。

column1: I had made a number of parachute drops inside 'unfriendly' countries:
column2: 我曾多次空降到「不友好」的国家：

column1: you would be surprised to know the full extent of my clandestine activities!
column2: 要是你知道我秘密行动的全貌，一定会大吃一惊！

column1: What you have to understand is that Spetsnaz was a GRU organization,
column2: 你得明白，特种部队隶属于格鲁乌，

column1: and the GRU (Soviet Military Intelligence) was directly under KGB control.
column2: 而格鲁乌（苏联军事情报局）直接受 KGB 管辖。

column1: So when I received an 'invitation' to join Department P of the KGB Second Directorate in Moscow, I was hardly in a position to refuse.
column2: 所以当我收到「邀请」，要我加入莫斯科 KGB 第二总局的 P 处时，我根本没有拒绝的余地。

column1: My father would have been horrified.
column2: 我父亲要是知道，一定会吓坏。

column1: As a GRU officer, he of course detested everything about the KGB.
column2: 身为格鲁乌军官，他当然痛恨 KGB 的一切。

column1: He and my mother are both dead, by the way...
column2: 顺带一提，他和我母亲都已经过世了……

column1: Blown up in a booby-trapped car in Tajikistan when I was still a boy.
column2: 在我还小的时候，他们在塔吉克斯坦死于一辆诡雷汽车的爆炸。

column1: I had never heard of this Department P.
column2: 我从没听说过这个 P 处。

column1: Uncle Vanya advised me to do my duty but watch my back.
column2: 万尼亚叔叔劝我尽忠职守，但要提防背后。

column1: Well, naturally he would say that...
column2: 嗯，他当然会这么说……

column1: He too is an ex-GRU officer.
column2: 他也是前格鲁乌军官。

column1: 'We are living in perilous times, Maks,' he said, 'and sometimes we are forced to do things we don't necessarily approve of'!
column2: 他说：「马克斯，我们活在危险的年代，有时不得不做些自己未必认同的事」！

column1: Vanya has always had a taste for the melodramatic.
column2: 万尼亚向来就爱小题大作。

column1: Maksim Mikhailovich...
column2: 马克西姆·米哈伊洛维奇……

column1: I am surprised at you, my son.
column2: 儿子，你真让我意外。

column1: They have finally put you in KGB uniform.
column2: 他们终究让你穿上了 KGB 的制服。

column1: At captain, no less.
column2: 还是上尉呢。

column1: But then, rooting out corruption in the very heart of the KGB should prove to be a worthy assignment for my idealistic son.
column2: 不过话说回来，到 KGB 的内核去根除腐败，对我这个怀抱理想的儿子来说，倒是件值得的差事。

column1: Beware, Maks, your naive enthusiasm.
column2: 马克斯，小心你那天真的热忱。

column1: You are running with a pack of wolves who would do anything to keep what they have stolen from the people of Russia.
column2: 你身边是一群狼，为了守住从俄国人民身上偷来的东西，他们什么都做得出来。

column1: When you get in trouble (and believe me, you will get into trouble), think of me.
column2: 等你遇上麻烦（相信我，你一定会遇上麻烦），就想想我。

column1: Imagine what I with my legendary intuition would have done to solve the problem.
column2: 想象一下，凭我那传奇般的直觉，会怎么解决问题。

column1: My intuition!
column2: 我的直觉！

column1: You see me now, Maks, as I live on in your memory, before your mother and I were blown to pieces in that booby-trapped car.
column2: 马克斯，你现在看到的我，是活在你记忆里的模样，在我和你母亲被那辆诡雷汽车炸得粉碎之前。

column1: So much for my intuition, huh?
column2: 我的直觉也不过如此，是吧？

column1: One last thing.
column2: 最后一件事。

column1: Buried somewhere beneath all the corruption is an ideal that many millions of honest people believed in.
column2: 在这一切腐败底下，埋藏着千百万正直的人曾经相信的理想。

column1: They may be fools but they deserve the truth.
column2: 他们也许是傻子，但他们有权知道真相。

column1: Find it for them, Maks.
column2: 马克斯，替他们找出真相吧。
